name: cleanroom_r2e_rhea128_to141_external_v1
purpose: Provide a genuinely fresh source-snapshot temporal external evaluation for the internally confirmed reaction-center residual, aligned to the exact 2023-07-12 snapshot boundary used by clean2023.

training_boundary.relationship_to_clean2023: data/external/enzymecage_current/catalyst_features/clean2023/summary.json states construction from the 2023-07-12 official snapshot

selection_without_model_scores.pair_delta: release141 Swiss-Prot MASTER_ID/ID pair is absent from release128
selection_without_model_scores.clean_boundary: delta trigger pair is absent from clean2023; both trigger protein and reaction entities are absent from clean2023 training entities
selection_without_model_scores.query_rule: a reaction becomes an evaluation query only if it has at least one supported release141-vs-128 delta trigger and every release141 positive protein for that query inside the fixed 185918-protein universe is protein-cold versus clean2023
selection_without_model_scores.positive_labels: for a selected query, label every release141 Swiss-Prot positive protein inside the fixed candidate universe, including old positives, to avoid creating known positives as artificial negatives

minimum_support_rule.if_below_minimum: mark the external benchmark underpowered and report descriptively; do not loosen newness, clean-boundary, all-positive-cold, or fixed-support rules

candidate.base_checkpoint: the full-clean2023 base trained immediately above

post_reveal_policy: No change to release numbers, query inclusion, candidate support, residual recipe or pass rule is allowed after release141 labels or candidate-vs-base performance are materialized. A failed or underpowered result remains failed/underpowered.
